verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm, but it publishes online tools and resources such as a UPC decision tracker and an investor-readiness tool, so an official MCP server is a plausible offering and the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no mention of an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint. Probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, both returning 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
